_meta.description: Model bake-off gate: supplementary Agent cases for the special cases the frozen 42-case set (agent_cases.json, unchanged) does not contain: explicit HDMI 2.1, invented-constraint traps, and multi-turn budget / size / technology / feature retention, budget override and budget release. Same schema and authoring rules as agent_cases.json, scored by the unchanged agent_eval.
authoring_rules: Written and hashed before the first candidate run; identical for every model; not tuned to any model's output.

User messages are taken from accepted assets: evaluation/guard_cases.json (4E.2), the 4E.2A inherited-constraint scenarios A-F (tests/test_semantic_guard.py) and the 4E.2A targeted live tests (docs/PHASE_4E_QUERY_SEMANTICS.md). The override case opens with a full request so that every turn is answerable.
Expectations encode only what the user text states or what earlier turns of the same conversation established. args: the effective state the Agent should send in that turn.
A first turn that states only a constraint ('До 120 тысяч.') expects no tool call; a tool call that carries exactly that constraint is acceptable.
Single-turn cases use the recommend family; multi-turn cases use the followup family, which the committed scorer reports separately from the headline.

sources.bake-mt-budget-retention: 4E.2A scenario A-budget-retention / targeted live test 1 (without the restart)
sources.bake-mt-budget-override: 4E.2A scenarios B-budget-override and C-budget-removal, after an explicit first request
